brief:
Gaza's first formal school year since the genocide has begun with intensified Israeli military shootings targeting teachers and pupils, according to Middle East Eye. The attacks have occurred as students attempt to return to classrooms across the territory, with air strikes reported alongside ground fire.

The resumption of formal education follows years of devastation to Gaza's school system, though the escalated violence now threatens classroom operations.

title: Israeli forces shoot at Gaza schoolchildren as classes resume
